# 5. Tables

##### Table 1

Magnitude statistics: Annual runoff, discharge, and recharge (inches) summary statistics for historical (H) and future (F) periods. % change = (F - H / H) of mean annual stat.

```{r table_1}
change <- wbm_annual %>%
  filter(year >= 1979 & year < 2065) %>%
  mutate(stat_group = ifelse(year < 2013, "Hist",
                             ifelse(year >= 2035, "Fut", "Present"))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(stat_group, CF, runoff_in_wbm) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF, stat_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarize_all(.funs = list(mean = mean, 
                                    #median = median, 
                                    sd = sd)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(stat_group != "Present",
                !(stat_group == "Hist" & CF == "Hot Dry"),
                !(stat_group == "Hist" & CF == "Warm Wet")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-stat_group) %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% # Convert to data frame (t() returns a matrix)
  set_names(.[1, ]) %>% # Set column names from the first row
  slice(-1)  %>% # Remove the first row (which now contains the column names)
  mutate(across(everything(), ~suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.))))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(`% Change Hot Dry` = 100 * (`Hot Dry` - Historical) / Historical,
                `% Change Warm Wet` = 100 * (`Warm Wet` - Historical) / Historical) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), .fns = ~ signif(.x, 3)))
  

kable(change)
```

##### Table 3

Storage ratio (S-D)

Summary of water use, storage tank size, and storage to demand ratio

```{r table_3}
# # Storage:Demand Ratio
# TP <- c("Annual Mean", "Annual Max", "Summer Mean", "Summer Max")

storage_vol <- 10000 * gal_to_cf

SD <- monthly_use_long %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(month_date = as.Date(month_date),
                month_days = days_in_month(month_date)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(period = ifelse(year(month_date) < 2012, "Historical", "Future")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(period) %>%
  dplyr::filter(mid_use == max(mid_use) |
                high_use == max(high_use)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(daily_use = 2 * mid_use / month_days,
                daily_use_high = 2 * high_use / month_days) %>%
  dplyr::mutate("Storage_cf" = storage_vol) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mid_use, high_use, daily_use, daily_use_high),
               names_to = "use_cat", values_to = "use") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(SD = Storage_cf / use,
                use = use,
                days_of_use = ifelse(grepl("daily", use_cat), SD, month_days * SD)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(c("Storage_cf", "low_use", "use"), .fns = ~ .x * cf_to_gal/1000)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), .fns = ~ signif(.x, 3)))
```

```{r snotel_figs}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)



plot_dat <- weather_data_an %>%
  dplyr::filter(id %in% select_station_list,
                waterYear > 1983,
                waterYear < 2025) %>%
  # 1. Standardize names: Variable_Source
  dplyr::rename("Snow Depth (in)_WS"   = snwd,
                "Max Temp (F)_WS"      = tmax,
                "Min Temp (F)_WS"      = tmin,
                "Precipitation (in)_WS" = prcp) %>%
  left_join(snotel_annual %>%
              dplyr::rename("SWE (in)_SS"           = wteq,
                            "Precipitation (in)_SS" = prec,
                            "Snow Depth (in)_SS"    = snwd),
            by = c("waterYear" = "water_year", "name")) %>%
  bind_rows(wbm_annual %>%
      dplyr::ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::filter(year < 2026) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(waterYear = year) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(name = "GridMET",
                    snowpack_in_wbm = snowpack_in_wbm * 0.00393701) %>%
      dplyr::select(waterYear, name, precip_in_wbm, snowpack_in_wbm, snow_in_wbm) %>%
      dplyr::rename("Precipitation (in)_WBM" = precip_in_wbm,
                    "Snow Depth (in)_WBM" = snowpack_in_wbm,
                    "SWE (in)_WBM" = snow_in_wbm)) %>%
  # 2. Pivot: This creates a 'variable' column and a 'data_source' column
  pivot_longer(cols = contains("_"),
               names_to = c("variable", "data_source"),
               names_sep = "_",
               values_to = "vals") %>%
  # 3. Calculate rolling means correctly grouped
  group_by(variable, name, data_source) %>%
  mutate(roll_vals = data.table::frollmean(vals, 5, align = "right")) %>%
  ungroup() 

# 4. Final Plot
weather_fig <- ggplot(plot_dat, aes(x = waterYear, color = name)) + 
  # Raw data lines (thin and dashed for source distinction)
  geom_line(aes(y = vals, linetype = data_source), lwd = 0.4, alpha = 0.4) +
  # Rolling mean lines
  geom_line(aes(y = roll_vals, group = interaction(name, data_source), linetype = data_source), 
            lwd = 1.1, lineend = "round") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_colorblind("Location") +
  scale_linetype_manual("Data Source", 
                        values = c("WS" = "solid", "SS" = "dotted", "WBM" = "dashed"),
                        labels = c("WS" = "Weather Station", "SS" = "SNOTEL", "WBM" = "NPS WBM")) +
  # Faceting by 'variable' now puts WS and SS on the same plot for Precip and Snow Depth
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", nrow = 3) + 
  labs(y = "Observed Value", x = "Water Year",
       title = "Comparison of Weather Station and SNOTEL Trends") + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.box = "vertical")
```

#### Water Budget

Plot of historical and projected annual water budget components for the contributing area of the proposed new well shown with a rolling 10-year average.

```{r wb_fig}
plot_dat <- wbm_annual %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(year,
                GCM,
                CF,
                "Precipitation (in)" = "precip_in_wbm",
                "Temperature (F)" = "tmean_F",
                "AET (in)" = "aet_in_wbm",
                "PET (in)" = "pet_in_wbm",
                #"Snowmelt (in)" = "melt_in_wbm",
                "Rain (in)" = "rain_in_wbm",
                "Snow (in)" = "snow_in_wbm",
                "Runoff (in)" = "runoff_in_wbm",
                "Inflow (gal)" = "inflow_open_months_gal") %>%
                #"Discharge (in)" = "discharge_in_wbm",
                #"Recharge (in)" = "recharge_in_wbm") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-c(year, GCM, CF), names_to = "vars", values_to = "vals") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(vars, CF, GCM) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(roll_vals = data.table::frollmean(vals, 10, align = c("center"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CF = factor(CF, levels = c("Historical", "Warm Wet", "Hot Dry")))

wb_fig <- ggplot(plot_dat) + 
  # Add shaded region between 2035 and 2065
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 2035, xmax = 2065, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            fill = "grey85", linewidth = 0,  alpha = .1) + 
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = vals, color = CF), lwd = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = roll_vals, group = CF), 
            lineend = "round", color = "black", lwd = 1.5) +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = roll_vals, color = CF),
            lineend = "round") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual("", values = c("Historical" = "#a9a9a9", "Hot Dry" = "#c5312a", "Warm Wet" = "#85b6dc")) +
  scale_fill_manual("", values = c("#a9a9a9", "#c5312a","#85b6dc"),
                    labels = c("Historical", "Hot Dry", "Warm Wet")) +
  labs(y = "", x = "") +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(vars, levels = c("Temperature (F)",
                                       "Precipitation (in)",
                                       "Rain (in)",
                                       "Snow (in)",
                                       #"Snowmelt (in)",
                                       "PET (in)",
                                       "AET (in)",
                                       "Runoff (in)",
                                       "Inflow (gal)")),
             scales = "free", nrow = 2) + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.margin = margin(t = -20, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0))

wb_fig

ggsave(wb_fig, filename = "data/park/GLAC/Figs/WaterBalance.tif", width = 9, height = 5,  dpi = 600)
```

#### Annual Runoff Variability

Plot showing runoff variability for historical and future CFs.

```{r}

pdat <- wbm_annual %>%
         dplyr::filter(year < 2100) %>%
         dplyr::mutate(Runoff = runoff_cf) 
  

hist_median <- median(pdat[pdat$year < 2013,]$Runoff, na.rm = TRUE) %>% as.numeric()
hist_q_low <- quantile(pdat[pdat$year < 2013,]$Runoff, .1, na.rm = TRUE) %>% as.numeric()
hist_q_high <- quantile(pdat[pdat$year < 2013,]$Runoff, .9, na.rm = TRUE) %>% as.numeric()

runoff_var <- ggplot(pdat %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(Runoff), values_to = "vals", names_to = "vars") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rect_min = ifelse(CF != "Historical", 2035, 1979),
                rect_max = ifelse(CF != "Historical", 2065, 2012),
                CF = factor(CF,levels=c("Historical","Hot Dry","Warm Wet")))) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = rect_min, xmax = rect_max, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),fill = "grey85", linewidth = 0,  alpha = .1) + 
  geom_bar(aes(x = year, y = vals, fill = CF,
               group = vars), stat = "identity", width = 0.9, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = hist_median, color = "Historical Median")) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = hist_q_low, color = "Historical 0.1 and 0.9 Quantile"), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = hist_q_high, color = "Historical 0.1 and 0.9 Quantile"), linetype = "dashed") +
 theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Annual Runoff (CF)") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = unit_format(unit = "M", scale = 1e-6)) +
  scale_fill_manual("", values = c("Historical" = "#a9a9a9", 
                                   "Hot Dry" = "#c5312a", 
                                   "Warm Wet" = "#85b6dc")) +
  scale_color_manual("", values = c("gray30", pal$black, "gray30")) +
  facet_wrap(~CF, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  theme(strip.background =element_rect(fill="gray95")) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black', face = "bold")) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.margin = margin(t = -15, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1)) 


runoff_var

# Calculate consecutive dry years
t <- pdat %>%
  dplyr::filter(year < 2012 | (year >= 2035 & year < 2065)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(r_lt_p1 = ifelse(Runoff <= hist_q_low, 1,0),
                r_gt_p90 = ifelse(Runoff  >= hist_q_high, 1,0),
                tot = ifelse(Runoff > 0, 1)) %>%
     dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(r_lt_p1, r_gt_p90, tot, CF, Runoff,year)

hist_rle <- rle(t[t$CF == "Historical",]$r_lt_p1)
hist_rle_max <- hist_rle$lengths[hist_rle$values == 1] %>% max()

d_rle <- rle(t[t$CF == "Drier",]$r_lt_p1)
d_rle_max <- d_rle$lengths[d_rle$values == 1] %>% max()

w_rle <- rle(t[t$CF == "Wetter",]$r_lt_p1)
w_rle_max <- w_rle$lengths[w_rle$values == 1] %>% max(na.rm = TRUE)

# Get maximum runoff during each time period
max_run <- t %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(max_runoff = max(Runoff, na.rm = TRUE))

# Get percentage increase for warm wet max compared to historical max
max_run[max_run$CF == "Wetter",][[2]] / max_run[max_run$CF == "Historical",][[2]]

# Print summary of extreme wet and dry years
t %>%
    dplyr::group_by(CF) %>%
  summarize_all(.funs = c(mean = mean, sum = sum)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lt_per = 100 * r_lt_p1_sum/tot_sum,
                gt_per = 100 * r_gt_p90_sum/tot_sum)


ggsave(runoff_var, filename = "data/park/GLAC/Figs/Runoff_Var.tif",
       dpi = 600, width = 7, height = 3)

```

##### Precip Extreme Events

Frequency of extreme (p99) precipitation events.

```{r extreme_runoff_frequency}

df <- wbm %>%
  dplyr::rename(cf = CF) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cf) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rolling_3day = frollapply(precip_in_wbm, FUN = "sum", n = 3, align = "center"),
                date = as_date(date),
                year = year(date)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(rolling_3day))

 df %>% dplyr::filter(year < 2070) %>% dplyr::group_by(cf) %>% dplyr::summarize(r = max(rolling_3day))

var = "precip_in_wbm"
q1 = 0.05 
q2 = 0.99

historic <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(cf == "Historical") %>%
  dplyr::rename("variable" = var) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Explore runoff events ONLY:
  dplyr::filter(rolling_3day > 0,
                # AND only data from 1979-2012
                year >= hist_yrs[1] & year < hist_yrs[2]) %>%
  dplyr::select(rolling_3day) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(QLOW = quantile(rolling_3day, probs = as.numeric(q1)),
                   QHIGH = quantile(rolling_3day, probs = as.numeric(q2)))

year_counts <- df %>%
  dplyr::rename("variable" = var) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(low_day = ifelse(rolling_3day <= historic$QLOW, 1, 0),
                high_day = ifelse(rolling_3day >= historic$QHIGH, 1, 0)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cf, year) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(n_low_days = sum(low_day),
                   n_high_days = sum(high_day)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(type = ifelse(cf == "Historical", "Historical", "Future"))

sanity_check <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(rolling_3day >= historic$QHIGH)

stats_precip <- year_counts %>%
  dplyr::filter(year >= hist_yrs[1] & year < hist_yrs[2] | year >= fut_yrs[1] & year < fut_yrs[2]) %>%
  group_by(cf) %>%
  summarize(count = sum(n_high_days, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean = mean(n_high_days, na.rm = TRUE))


xx <- ggplot(year_counts %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rect_min = ifelse(cf != "Historical", 2035, 1979),
                rect_max = ifelse(cf != "Historical", 2065, 2012),
                CF = factor(cf,levels=c("Historical","Hot Dry","Warm Wet")))) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = rect_min, xmax = rect_max, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),fill = "grey85", linewidth = 0,  alpha = .1) + 
  geom_bar(aes(x = year, y = n_high_days, fill = CF), stat = "identity", width = 0.9, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
 theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Number Precipitation Events ≥ p99") +
  #scale_y_continuous(labels = unit_format(unit = "M", scale = 1e-6)) +
  scale_fill_manual("", values = c("Historical" = "#a9a9a9", "Hot Dry" = "#c5312a", "Warm Wet" = "#85b6dc")) +
  scale_color_manual("", values = c("gray30", pal$black, "gray30")) +
  facet_wrap(~CF, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  theme(strip.background =element_rect(fill="gray95")) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black', face = "bold")) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.margin = margin(t = -15, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0))



xx

ggsave(xx, filename = "data/park/GLAC/Figs/Extreme_Precip_events.jpg", dpi = 600, height = 3, width = 7.5)
```

#### Seasonality

A plot of the seasonality of historical and projected rain, snowmelt, actual ET, runoff, recharge, and discharge.

```{r figure_12}
# Create Seasonal Dataframe
sum_cols <- c("aet_in_wbm","melt_in_wbm","pet_in_wbm","rain_in_wbm","runoff_in_wbm","snow_in_wbm", "precip_in_wbm", "runoff_gal", "runoff_cf")
mean_cols <- c("excess_water_in_wbm","tmean_C") 

seasonal_wbm <- wbm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(season = case_when(month(date) %in% c(12,1,2) ~ "Winter",
                                   month(date) %in% c(3,4,5) ~ "Spring",
                                   month(date) %in% c(6,7,8) ~ "Summer",
                                   month(date) %in% c(9,10,11) ~ "Fall")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(y = year(date)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(date,GCM)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(y,season,CF)%>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    across(all_of(sum_cols),sum),  # Sum of columns in sum_cols list
    across(all_of(mean_cols),mean),
    .groups = "keep") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CF = factor(CF, levels = c("Historical", "Hot Dry", "Warm Wet")))

seasonal_stats <- seasonal_wbm %>%
  dplyr::group_by(y, CF) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(runoff_fraction = as.numeric(100* runoff_in_wbm/sum(runoff_in_wbm))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF, season) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(runoff = mean(runoff_in_wbm),
                   runoff_fraction = mean(runoff_fraction)) %>%
  #dplyr::filter(season %in% c("Spring", "Fall")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF, season) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(runoff_fraction = sum(runoff_fraction),
                   runoff = mean(runoff)) 

hist_seasonal_stats <- seasonal_stats %>% dplyr::filter(CF == "Historical") %>%
  dplyr::rename(c("runoff_fraction_hist" = "runoff_fraction",
                  "runoff_hist" = "runoff")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(season, runoff_hist)

seasonal_stats <- seasonal_stats %>%
  left_join(hist_seasonal_stats , by = "season") %>%
  dplyr::filter(CF != "Historical") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(runoff_change = 100 * (runoff - runoff_hist) / runoff_hist)
```

#### Tank Storage

Track tank storage through time during dry, wet, and average years.
```{r sup_dem_tank_storage}
# Define Tank Capacity
tank_cap_gal <- 10000

pdat <- monthly_use %>%
  left_join(wbm_monthly %>%
              dplyr::select(ym, CF, runoff_cf),
            by = "ym") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(year = year(ym), 
                month = month(ym)) %>%
  drop_na(CF) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF, year, GCM) %>%
  # 1. Convert all units to Gallons
  dplyr::mutate(
    monthly_sup_gal      = runoff_cf * cf_to_gal,
    #monthly_sup_gal_low  = runoff_cf_low * cf_to_gal,
    #monthly_sup_gal_high = runoff_cf_high * cf_to_gal,
    monthly_use_gal      = monthly_use_mid * cf_to_gal,
    monthly_use_gal_low  = monthly_use_low * cf_to_gal,
    monthly_use_gal_high = monthly_use_high * cf_to_gal
  ) %>%
 # Storage Simulation with Deficit Tracking
dplyr::group_modify(~ {
  
  calc_storage_details <- function(sup_vec, dem_vec) {
    res <- purrr::accumulate2(sup_vec, dem_vec, function(prev, sup, dem) {
      # Current balance before constraints
      potential_water <- prev$level + sup - dem
      
      # Level is constrained between 0 and Capacity
      actual_level <- max(0, min(tank_cap_gal, potential_water))
      
      # DEFICIT LOGIC: 
      # A deficit only occurs if the demand was greater than (current level + supply)
      shortfall <- ifelse(potential_water < 0, abs(potential_water), 0)
      
      list(level = actual_level, deficit = shortfall)
    }, .init = list(level = tank_cap_gal, deficit = 0))[-1]
    
    purrr::map_df(res, ~.)
  }
  
  avg_res <- calc_storage_details(.x$monthly_sup_gal, .x$monthly_use_gal)
  
  # Map results back to the dataframe
  .x %>% mutate(
    tank_storage_gal = avg_res$level,
    deficit_gal      = avg_res$deficit, # Use the accurate loop-calculated deficit
    # Repeat for low/high if tracking those levels
    tank_storage_gal_low  = calc_storage_details(.x$monthly_sup_gal, .x$monthly_use_gal_high)$level,
    tank_storage_gal_high = calc_storage_details(.x$monthly_sup_gal, .x$monthly_use_gal_low)$level
  )
}) %>%
 
  # 3. Grouping and Summarization
  dplyr::mutate(plot_group = case_when(
    year >= 2015 & year < 2025 ~ "Recent Historical (2015-2025)",
    year >= 2045 & year < 2055 ~ "Future Mid-Century (2045-2055)",
    year >= 2090 & year < 2100 ~ "Future Late-Century (2090-2100)",
    TRUE ~ NA)) %>%
  drop_na(plot_group) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(month, CF, plot_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    avg_tank_level  = mean(tank_storage_gal, na.rm = TRUE),
    low_tank_level  = mean(tank_storage_gal_low, na.rm = TRUE),
    high_tank_level = mean(tank_storage_gal_high, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_monthly_deficit = mean(deficit_gal, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ym = as.Date(paste0("2020-", month, "-01"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(plot_group = factor(plot_group,
                                     levels=c("Recent Historical (2015-2025)",
                                              "Future Mid-Century (2045-2055)",
                                              "Future Late-Century (2090-2100)")),
                 CF = factor(CF, levels = c("Historical", "Hot Dry", "Warm Wet"))) 

track_storage_fig <- ggplot(pdat, aes(x = ym, fill = CF)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = low_tank_level, ymax = high_tank_level), alpha = .3, lwd = 0) +
  geom_line(aes(y = avg_tank_level), color = "black", lwd = 1.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y = avg_tank_level, color = CF), lwd = 1) +
#  geom_line(aes(y = -total_monthly_deficit, color = CF), lwd = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~plot_group) +
  labs(y = "Tank Level (gallons)", x = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual("", values = c(nps_pal$grey, nps_pal$red, nps_pal$blue)) +
  scale_fill_manual("", values = c(nps_pal$grey, nps_pal$red, nps_pal$blue)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.margin = margin(t = -20, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0))

track_storage_fig


ggsave(track_storage_fig, filename = "data/park/CEBR/Figs/track_storage.tif",
       dpi = 600, width = 7, height = 2.5)
```

####- Explore WBM XY

Can only run this section if the WBM isn't aggregated.

```{r annual_stats_by_xy}

wbm_xy_stats <- wbm_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(year = year(date),
    stat_period = 
                  ifelse(year < 2013, "Baseline",
                      ifelse(year > 2034 & year < 2065, "Future", "Other"))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!stat_period == "Other") %>%
  dplyr::select(GCM, stat_period, x, y, Skill, precip_in_wbm, tmean_C, runoff_in_wbm, pet_in_wbm) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(GCM, stat_period, Skill, x, y) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean_precip_in = mean(precip_in_wbm),
                   mean_tmean_C = mean(tmean_C),
                   mean_runoff_in = mean(runoff_in_wbm),
                   median_runoff_in = quantile(runoff_in_wbm, 0.75),
                   sd_runoff_in = sd(runoff_in_wbm),
                   cv_runoff_in = sd(runoff_in_wbm)/mean(runoff_in_wbm),
                   iqr_runoff_in = as.numeric(quantile(runoff_in_wbm, 0.75)) - 
                     as.numeric(quantile(runoff_in_wbm, 0.25)),
                   q90_q10_runoff_in = as.numeric(quantile(runoff_in_wbm, 0.9)) -
                     as.numeric(quantile(runoff_in_wbm, 0.1)),
                   peak_runoff_in = max(runoff_in_wbm),
                   mean_precip_minus_pet_in = mean(precip_in_wbm - pet_in_wbm),
                   fract_zero_runoff = sum(runoff_in_wbm == 0) / n() ,
                   .groups = "keep") 

baseline_xy <- wbm_xy_stats %>%
  dplyr::filter(stat_period == "Baseline") %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_baseline"), all_of(c("mean_precip_in", "mean_tmean_C", "mean_runoff_in", 
                    "median_runoff_in", "sd_runoff_in", "cv_runoff_in", 
                    "iqr_runoff_in", "q90_q10_runoff_in", "peak_runoff_in", 
                    "mean_precip_minus_pet_in", "fract_zero_runoff"))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-stat_period)


future_xy <- wbm_xy_stats %>%
  dplyr::filter(!stat_period == "Baseline") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-stat_period)


future_differentials_xy <- future_xy %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  left_join(baseline_xy %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>% dplyr::select(-c(GCM, Skill)), by = c("x","y")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(delta_precip_in = mean_precip_in - mean_precip_in_baseline,
                delta_tmean_C = mean_tmean_C - mean_tmean_C_baseline,
                delta_runoff_in = 365.25 *(mean_runoff_in - mean_runoff_in_baseline),
                delta_runoff_in_sd = sd_runoff_in - sd_runoff_in_baseline) %>%
                #delta_runoff_in_cv = cv_runoff_in - baseline$cv_runoff_in,
                #delta_runoff_in_iqr = iqr_runoff_in - baseline$iqr_runoff_in,
                #delta_runoff_in_median = median_runoff_in - baseline$median_runoff_in,
                #delta_runoff_q90_q10 = q90_q10_runoff_in - baseline$q90_q10_runoff_in,
                #delta_runoff_in_peak = peak_runoff_in - baseline$peak_runoff_in,
                #delta_precip_minus_pet = mean_precip_minus_pet_in - baseline$mean_precip_minus_pet_in,
                #delta_fract_zero_runoff = fract_zero_runoff - baseline$fract_zero_runoff) %>%
  #dplyr::left_join(centroid_cfs %>% dplyr::select(GCM, CF), by = "GCM") %>%
  #dplyr::rename(c("centroid_cf" = CF)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(centroid_cf = ifelse(centroid_cf %in% c("Hot Dry","Warm Wet"), centroid_cf , 
                            ifelse(Skill == "Low Skill", "Low Skill", "Other"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(RCP = str_sub(GCM, -5))  %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(selected_gcms[[1]] %>% 
                     dplyr::filter(CF %in% c("Hot Dry", "Warm Wet")) %>% 
                     dplyr::select(c(GCM, "select_CF" = CF)), by = "GCM") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(GCM_Meta = case_when(centroid_cf == "Low Skill" ~ "Low Skill",
                                     !is.na(select_CF) ~ select_CF,
                                     TRUE ~ "Other")) 


future_differentials_xy_sf <- future_differentials_xy %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)


# PLOT
# First, extract diff_runoff and convert to raster for each GCM
runoff_raster <- st_as_stars(future_differentials_xy_sf %>% 
                               dplyr::select(x,y,GCM,delta_precip_in), #%>%
                             dims = c("x", "y", "GCM"), 
                             name = "delta_precip_in")


runoff_raster <- future_differentials_xy %>%
  dplyr::mutate(x = round(x, 4), y = round(y, 4)) %>% # Rounding forces a regular grid
  dplyr::select(x, y, GCM, delta_runoff_in) %>%
  st_as_stars(dims = c("x", "y", "GCM"), dx = 4000, dy = 4000)


# Plot a map of the grid cells for each GCM
ggplot() +
  geom_stars(data = runoff_raster) +
  geom_sf(data = select_sources$watershed[[1]], fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = .5) +
  facet_wrap(~GCM, nrow = 5) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu", name = "Delta Runoff (in)", direction = 1, na.value = "transparent") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "30-Year Runoff Delta by GCM") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank()
  )
ggsave("data/park/GLAC/Figs/delta_runoff_grid.jpg", dpi = 600)


# Plot a density distribution of the percentage change for each grid call across
# the 40 GCMs

ggplot(future_differentials_xy %>%
         dplyr::mutate(loc = paste0("Coords: ",round(x,3)," , ", round(y,3)))) +
  geom_density(aes(x = delta_runoff_in), 
                 bins = 30, 
                 fill = "steelblue", 
                 color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~loc, scales = "free_y") +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Projected Delta Runoff",
    subtitle = "Dashed line represents zero change (baseline)",
    x = "Delta Precip (inches)",
    y = "Frequency (Grid Cells)"
  )
```

```{r explore_differences}
test <- get_nps_wbm_params(clim_pts, area_weighted = FALSE) %>%

fut_dif_summary <- future_differentials_xy %>%
  dplyr::filter(x <= -113.72 &

  dplyr::summarize(delta_runoff_in_mean = mean(delta_runoff_in, na.rm = TRUE),

  left_join(test, by = c("x","y"))
```
